records.researcher_notes: GEM does not list this plant. The Bureau of Land Management project page for the Saddle Butte Eastside Power Generation Facility describes a gas peaker near Bloomfield, San Juan County, and posts the right-of-way decision of July 2, 2026. It is the sister site of Saddle Butte's Westside plant at Kirtland, which GEM already holds. The Southwest Power Pool queue request FEUS-4, 60 megawatts of gas near Bloomfield, is most likely this plant, but the queue does not name it, so a question card asks. The point is placed east of Bloomfield and is approximate. Saddle Butte Energy Farmington is already in the entity list.

records.plant_name: Zenith Volts Roswell Data Center power station

verifications.note: Zenith Volts press release of August 2025. The data center 20 miles south of Roswell in Chaves County won county approval, plans natural gas generators for dependable backup and targets operation by November 2027.

records.researcher_notes: GEM does not list this plant. Zenith Volts' press release of August 2025 says Chaves County approved its data center 20 miles south of Roswell, that it will use natural gas generators for dependable backup, and that it targets operation by November 2027. No air permit application was found in the state permit harvest, and the Chaves County records read in the local records harvest mention only solar and battery storage, so the size of the gas fleet is unknown. The point is placed 20 miles south of Roswell and is approximate. Zenith Volts is not in the entity list and needs to be created. This answers row 340 of the possible updates sheet.
